errors.evidence: The y-axis tick labels end at 0.960. While one data point for the 'CoRe' series is slightly above 0.960 (at approx. 0.961), stating the span reaches 0.962 is an overestimation and mischaracterizes the visible axis range.

At the x-axis value of 2, the data points for both '0-CoT' and 'CoRe' series appear to have the exact same y-value. The description provides a value of 'about 0.934' for '0-CoT' but 'about 0.935' for 'CoRe' at this point, creating an inconsistency for what is visually an intersection point.
The description omits any mention of the legend located in the top-right corner of the plot, which is crucial for associating the line styles and markers with the '0-CoT' and 'CoRe' methods.
